worldFact.fact: Baarle is divided by 22 separate Belgian parcels inside the Netherlands and eight Dutch counter-enclaves inside Belgium. The international border cuts directly through streets, bars and living rooms, where a resident's nationality and tax status are legally determined by which side their front door sits on.
